get.description: Each SSE message has `id` (the event's sequence number), `event` (its type) and `data` (the Event as JSON). Reconnect with Last-Event-ID to replay what you missed; if it is too old you get a `reset` event and should refetch. Every API response carries Ka-Event-Seq, the last event ID at that moment. A `: ping` comment is sent every 15 s. Data payloads: TicketEvent (ticket.*), ClaimEvent (claim.changed), CommentEvent (comment.created, question.*), SyncState (sync.state), Change (presence.changed).
